dhpak2.4:3.1: Ekasmiñhi samaye sāvatthiyaṃ bālanakkhattaṃ nāma saṅghuṭṭhaṃ.
dhpak2.4:3.2: Tasmiṃ nakkhatte bālā dummedhino janā chārikāya ceva gomayena
dhpak2.4:3.3: ca sarīraṃ makkhetvā sattāhaṃ asabbhaṃ bhaṇantā vicaranti.
dhpak2.4:3.4: Kiñci ñāti suhajjaṃ vā pabbajitaṃ vā disvā lajjantā
dhpak2.4:3.5: nāma natthi. Dvāre dvāre ṭhatvā asabbhaṃ bhaṇanti.
dhpak2.4:3.7: yathābalaṃ aḍḍhaṃ vā pādaṃ vā kahāpaṇaṃ vā pesenti.
dhpak2.4:3.8: Te tesaṃ dvāre laddhaṃ laddhaṃ gahetvā pakkamanti.
dhpak2.4:4.1: Tadā pana sāvatthiyaṃ pañca koṭimattā ariyasāvakā vasanti, te
dhpak2.4:4.2: satthu santikaṃ sāsanaṃ pesayiṃsu – “bhagavā, bhante, sattāhaṃ
dhpak2.4:4.3: bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ nagaraṃ appavisitvā vihāreyeva hotū”ti.
dhpak2.4:4.4: Tañca pana sattāhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghassa vihāreyeva yāgubhattādīni
dhpak2.4:4.5: sampādetvā pahiṇiṃsu, sayampi gehā na nikkhamiṃsu.
dhpak2.4:5.1: Te nakkhatte pana pariyosite aṭṭhame divase buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ nimantetvā
dhpak2.4:5.2: nagaraṃ pavesetvā mahādānaṃ datvā ekamantaṃ nisinnā,
dhpak2.4:5.3: “bhante, atidukkhena no satta divasāni atikkantāni, bālānaṃ asabbhāni suṇantānaṃ
dhpak2.4:5.4: kaṇṇā bhijjanākārappattā honti, koci kassaci na lajjati, tena mayaṃ tumhākaṃ
dhpak2.4:5.5: antonagaraṃ pavisituṃ nādamha, mayampi gehato na nikkhamimhā”ti āhaṃsu.
dhpak2.4:6.1: Satthā tesaṃ kathaṃ sutvā, “bālānaṃ dummedhānaṃ kiriyā nāma
dhpak2.4:6.2: evarūpā hoti, medhāvino pana dhanasāraṃ viya appamādaṃ rakkhitvā
dhpak2.4:6.3: amatamahānibbānasampattiṃ pāpuṇantī”ti vatvā imā gāthā abhāsi –
dhpak2.4:7.1: 26. “Pamādamanuyuñjanti, bālā dummedhino janā; Appamādañca medhāvī, dhanaṃ seṭṭhaṃva rakkhati.
dhpak2.4:8.2: Appamatto hi jhāyanto, pappoti vipulaṃ sukha”nti.
dhpak2.4:9.1: Tattha bālāti bālyena samannāgatā idhalokaparalokatthaṃ ajānantā. Dummedhinoti nippaññā. Te pamāde ādīnavaṃ apassantā pamādaṃ
dhpak2.4:9.2: anuyuñjanti pavattenti, pamādena kālaṃ vītināmenti. Medhāvīti dhammojapaññāya samannāgato pana paṇḍito kulavaṃsāgataṃ seṭṭhaṃ
dhpak2.4:9.3: uttamaṃ sattaratanadhanaṃ viya appamādaṃ rakkhati. Yathā hi uttamaṃ dhanaṃ nissāya “kāmaguṇasampattiṃ pāpuṇissāma,
dhpak2.4:9.4: puttadāraṃ posessāma, paralokagamanamaggaṃ sodhessāmā”ti dhane ānisaṃsaṃ passantā taṃ rakkhanti, evaṃ paṇḍitopi appamatto
dhpak2.4:9.5: “paṭhamajjhānādīni paṭilabhissāmi, maggaphalādīni pāpuṇissāmi, tisso vijjā, cha abhiññā sampādessāmī”ti appamāde ānisaṃsaṃ
dhpak2.4:9.6: passanto dhanaṃ seṭṭhaṃva appamādaṃ rakkhatīti attho. Mā pamādanti tasmā tumhe mā pamādamanuyuñjetha mā pamādena kālaṃ
dhpak2.4:9.7: vītināmayittha. Mā kāmaratisanthavanti vatthukāmakilesakāmesu ratisaṅkhātaṃ taṇhāsanthavampi mā anuyuñjetha mā cintayittha
dhpak2.4:9.8: mā paṭilabhittha. Appamatto hīti upaṭṭhitassatitāya hi appamatto jhāyanto puggalo vipulaṃ uḷāraṃ nibbānasukhaṃ pāpuṇātīti.
dhpak2.4:10.1: Gāthāpariyosāne bahū sotāpannādayo ahesuṃ. Mahājanassa sātthikā dhammadesanā jātāti.
